content:
We got our hands on some iPhone 18 Pro accessories before our Friday delivery, so you can have a look. In my opinion, Apple's AirTag 2 and the all-new AirPods Pro 3 (or AirPods 5) are the best accessories you can buy for your new iPhone 18 Pro, not to mention the world's greatest Polishing Cloth, but this time we're going deeper — chargers, MagSafe stands, cases, wallets, and more. Scroll down to take a look.

iPhone 18 Pro Accessories

  • Chance — Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter (up to 60W)
  • Ben — Apple TechWoven Case
  • Michael — Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger
  • Arin — Apple iPhone FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe
  • Ryan — iPhone 18 Pro MagSafe Car Mount
  • Fernando — Burgundy Picogo Air Slim External Battery
  • Simon — Baseus Enercore 70W Retractable USB-C Travel Adapter
  • Justin — Satechi 25W 3-in-1 Qi2 Desktop Charger
  • Reinette — Spigen Ultra Hybrid MagFit Case
  • Some Honorable Mentions

If you want to charge your new iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max at the fastest possible speed, you'll need a compatible charging brick. Specifically, you'll need one that supports Adjustable Voltage Supply (AVS), and Apple's offering is the best one on the market. It features a compact, foldable design, and can charge your iPhone 18 Pro or iPhone 18 Pro Max up to 50% in just 15 minutes.

Apple's TechWoven Case combines an attractive aesthetic, a grippy texture in the hand, wonderfully tactile anodized aluminum buttons, and a range of deep color options — all while being made from 100% recycled polyester fiber with environmental certifications.

Anker's compact 3-in-1 wireless charger can power three devices simultaneously from a single portable accessory, and will charge your iPhone via Qi2 wireless charging that is MagSafe compatible. It folds down to a small footprint and easily slips into a travel bag, letting you leave multiple cables and bricks at home — or just keep your whole Apple kit neatly organized on a nightstand or desk. And it's down close to 35% today, making it an all-time low on Amazon.

Apple's FineWoven Wallet with MagSafe remains the iPhone accessory for minimalists. It can comfortably hold 3 to 4 cards, whether it's an ID, a few credit cards, or an access card, perfect for those who don't want to lug around a bulky wallet.

Whenever I'm driving, I want a secure and stable place to put my iPhone. ESR's MagSafe car mount is my top pick. You can magnetically attach an iPhone 18 Pro or an older model to the mount, and the mount conveniently clips onto your car's air vent. A MagSafe mount is a great way to securely hold your iPhone while you're on the road, visible and ready, while also charging.

I've always believed that if you're going to slap a MagSafe battery pack onto your iPhone and use it, it should be as thin as possible. Baseus just released my perfect MagSafe battery pack. The Picogo Air is only 0.27 inches thick and weighs 3.7 ounces. It has a built-in 5,000mAh battery, 7.5W wireless charging, and up to 22.5W wired charging. The best part is that they have color options specifically designed to match the new Burgundy iPhone. A true MagSafe battery pack should be designed this way — with thinness as the priority.

If you travel frequently, you know that keeping your tech bag organized is half the battle. That's why I've been on the lookout for versatile charging gear. Baseus' travel adapter fits the bill perfectly, supporting plugs in over 200 countries worldwide, and it's designed to power six devices simultaneously. But for me, the biggest selling point is the built-in 70W retractable USB-C cable, which lets you charge your iPhone 18 Pro at full speed while also delivering stable charging output to devices like an iPad or MacBook.

As mentioned above, Michael picked what I personally consider to be the best travel-friendly foldable MagSafe charger, but I'll focus on my two favorite 3-in-1 desktop models: one is the super sleek and minimalist 25W Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 Desktop Charger in a gorgeous Space Black; the other is the Anker Smart Display 3-in-1 model that I also really like, but Satechi's is just too elegant, refined, and tasteful to beat.

After getting an iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, I usually go for relatively affordable accessories rather than the top-tier options, and Spigen has plenty of budget-friendly MagSafe cases. My top pick is this clear Ultra Hybrid MagFit case, which is priced far below other brands, or its opaque multicolor version — both support MagSafe for fast wireless charging. They also feature side TPU panels infused with DuraClear blue resin to prevent yellowing, and the design includes shock absorption; not many people know that the camera control button is also covered with a thin layer of TPU.
